- Wed Dec 9, 9:00–12:30 PT (preferred)
- Thu Dec 10, 1:00–4:30 PT
- Tue Dec 15, 9:00–12:30 PT

- Please review the Onboarding Packet and sign the DocuSign by EOD Dec 8. [attachment: Docusign_Manager_Acknowledgement.pdf]
- Complete the 10-minute pre-work survey (link below) so PeopleLearn can tailor scenarios to your org.
- Confirm if you want the session to include engineers' role-play (we can bring one L&D coach for small groups).
